name: dag-viz
title: Contract DAG export for visualization
interface: CLI: node tools/graph.mjs [--dir <project>] [--format mermaid|dot|json] [--structural]. Emits the contract DAG with per-node derived status (done/open/deprecated) and per-edge submission verdicts: json for programmatic use, mermaid and dot for direct rendering. Edges run parent -> import; ACCEPTED edges are solid, sketch edges dashed.
nl_description: Makes the DAG visible: what is Done, what is Open, which sketches wait on which children. The json output is the data source for any UI; mermaid/dot render directly in editors, CI summaries, and docs.
